The [[Je'daii Journeyer]] [[Lanoree Brock]], kept a '''private journal''' recorded by her droid [[Ironholgs]]. At one point she made an entry about the mission to find her brother.

==Behind the scenes==
An entry in Lanoree Brock's Journal was released as part of the promotion for the book ''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''.
